```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:evidence-envelope",
  "title": "evidence-envelope",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:evidence-envelope"
    },
    "schema_version": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "evidence_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "run_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "producer_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "contract_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "tick_ns": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
      "description": "TAI-relative nanoseconds as decimal string; semantic validator enforces int64 range"
    },
    "valid_interval": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "start_ns": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
          "description": "TAI-relative nanoseconds as decimal string; semantic validator enforces int64 range"
        },
        "end_ns": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
          "description": "TAI-relative nanoseconds as decimal string; semantic validator enforces int64 range"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "start_ns",
        "end_ns"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "subject_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "payload_schema": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^urn:space-sim:design:v1:[a-z0-9:-]+$"
    },
    "payload": {
      "type": "object"
    },
    "quality": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "valid": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "level": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "nominal",
            "degraded",
            "invalid"
          ]
        },
        "reason": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "valid",
        "level",
        "reason"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "allOf": [
        {
          "if": {
            "properties": {
              "valid": {
                "const": false
              }
            }
          },
          "then": {
            "properties": {
              "level": {
                "const": "invalid"
              },
              "reason": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1
              }
            }
          },
          "else": {
            "properties": {
              "level": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "nominal",
                  "degraded"
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    "provenance": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "kind": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "synthetic",
            "imported",
            "derived"
          ]
        },
        "source_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
        },
        "description": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "content_hash": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "kind",
        "source_id",
        "description",
        "content_hash"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "source_commit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0
    },
    "source_revision_kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "committed",
        "staged-phase"
      ]
    },
    "transaction_id": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "phase_snapshot_hash": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schema_id",
    "schema_version",
    "evidence_id",
    "run_id",
    "producer_id",
    "contract_id",
    "tick_ns",
    "valid_interval",
    "subject_ids",
    "payload_schema",
    "payload",
    "quality",
    "provenance",
    "source_commit",
    "source_revision_kind",
    "transaction_id",
    "phase_snapshot_hash"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "allOf": [
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "source_revision_kind": {
            "const": "staged-phase"
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "transaction_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          }
        }
      },
      "else": {
        "properties": {
          "transaction_id": {
            "type": "null"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

### C011 实验锁 / ExperimentLock

完整 JSON Schema 2020-12；结构校验之外仍需引用与领域语义校验。

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:experiment-lock",
  "title": "experiment-lock",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:experiment-lock"
    },
    "lock_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "content_hash": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
    },
    "physical_experiment_hash": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
    },
    "evaluation_profile_hash": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
    },
    "template_ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "resolved_profiles": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "slot": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "conditions",
              "dynamics",
              "adjudication",
              "scoring",
              "run_policy"
            ]
          },
          "profile_ref": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
          },
          "content_hash": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
          },
          "expanded_document": {
            "type": "object"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "slot",
          "profile_ref",
          "content_hash",
          "expanded_document"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 5
    },
    "planned_runs": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1
    },
    "execution_graph_hash": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
    },
    "writer_map_hash": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
    },
    "input_manifest_hash": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
    },
    "validator_version": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "canonicalizer_version": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "seed_plan": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "master_seed": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$",
          "description": "Unsigned seed decimal; semantic validator enforces 0 <= value <= 18446744073709551615. Not a time quantity."
        },
        "seed_block_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
        },
        "replicate_count": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1
        },
        "rng_derivation_version": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "master_seed",
        "seed_block_id",
        "replicate_count",
        "rng_derivation_version"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "dependency_manifest": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "kind": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "profile",
              "template",
              "plugin",
              "contract",
              "input",
              "adapter",
              "metric",
              "resolver",
              "engine"
            ]
          },
          "ref": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
          },
          "content_hash": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "kind",
          "ref",
          "content_hash"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 1
    },
    "compatibility_report_hash": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
    },
    "override_provenance": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "path": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "source_layer": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "component_schema_defaults",
              "experiment_template_defaults",
              "profile_parent_chain",
              "selected_profile",
              "experiment_instance_overrides",
              "explicit_sweep_point"
            ]
          },
          "value": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "number",
              "boolean",
              "null"
            ]
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "path",
          "source_layer",
          "value"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 0
    },
    "run_matrix": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "run_plan_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "case_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "case_hash": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
          },
          "case_parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": [
                "string",
                "number",
                "boolean",
                "null"
              ]
            }
          },
          "condition_block": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "replicate_index": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 0
          },
          "scenario_lock_hash": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "run_plan_id",
          "case_id",
          "case_hash",
          "case_parameters",
          "condition_block",
          "replicate_index",
          "scenario_lock_hash"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 1
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schema_id",
    "lock_id",
    "content_hash",
    "physical_experiment_hash",
    "evaluation_profile_hash",
    "template_ref",
    "resolved_profiles",
    "planned_runs",
    "execution_graph_hash",
    "writer_map_hash",
    "input_manifest_hash",
    "validator_version",
    "canonicalizer_version",
    "seed_plan",
    "dependency_manifest",
    "compatibility_report_hash",
    "override_provenance",
    "run_matrix"
  ],

}
```

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:experiment-template",
  "title": "experiment-template",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:experiment-template"
    },
    "template_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "version": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "profiles": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "conditions": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "dynamics": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "adjudication": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "scoring": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "run_policy": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "conditions",
        "dynamics",
        "adjudication",
        "scoring",
        "run_policy"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "allowed_override_paths": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1
      },
      "minItems": 0,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "overrides": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "path": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "value": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "number",
              "boolean",
              "null"
            ]
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "path",
          "value"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 0
    },
    "sweep": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "design": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "cartesian",
            "paired"
          ]
        },
        "axes": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "path": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "values": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": [
                    "string",
                    "number",
                    "boolean",
                    "null"
                  ]
                },
                "minItems": 1,
                "uniqueItems": true
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "path",
              "values"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "minItems": 0
        },
        "excluded_conditions": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:predicate"
          },
          "minItems": 0
        }
      },
      "required": [

        "axes",
        "excluded_conditions"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "comparison_policy": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [

      ]
    },

  "required": [

    "profiles",
    "allowed_override_paths",
    "overrides",

}
```

### C013 指标定义 / MetricDefinition

完整 JSON Schema 2020-12；结构校验之外仍需引用与领域语义校验。

Schema 文件：`metric-definition.schema.json`；实例文件：`metric-definition.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "schema_id": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:metric-definition",
  "metric_id": "valid_sample_fraction",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "label": "有效已发出科学样本比例",
  "input_contracts": [
    {
      "contract_id": "science.sample.created",
      "version": "1.0.0",
      "fields": [
        "run_id",
        "event_id",
        "quality.valid"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "required_fields": [
    "science.sample.created.run_id",
    "science.sample.created.event_id",
    "science.sample.created.quality.valid"
  ],
  "required_complete_contracts": [
    "science.sample.created@1.0.0"
  ],
  "window": {
    "start_ns": "0",
    "end_ns": "3600000000000"
  },
  "reducer": {
    "op": "fraction",
    "predicate": {
      "op": "eq",
      "field": "quality.valid",
      "value": true
    }
  },
  "unit": "1",
  "direction": "maximize",
  "missing_policy": "undefined",
  "valid_range": {
    "lower": 0,
    "upper": 1
  },
  "implementation_ref": "builtin.metric.fraction@1.0.0",
  "test_fixtures": [
    "metrics/valid-samples-complete",
    "metrics/valid-samples-empty",
    "metrics/duplicate-event"
  ],
  "deduplicate_by": [
    "run_id",
    "event_id"
  ]
}
```

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:metric-definition",
  "title": "metric-definition",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:metric-definition"
    },
    "metric_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "version": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "input_contracts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "contract_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "version": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
          },
          "fields": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
            },
            "minItems": 1,
            "uniqueItems": true
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "contract_id",
          "version",
          "fields"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 1
    },
    "required_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "required_complete_contracts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "window": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "start_ns": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
          "description": "TAI-relative nanoseconds as decimal string; semantic validator enforces int64 range"
        },
        "end_ns": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
          "description": "TAI-relative nanoseconds as decimal string; semantic validator enforces int64 range"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "start_ns",
        "end_ns"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "reducer": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "op": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "count",
            "sum",
            "mean",
            "min",
            "max",
            "fraction",
            "interval-utilization",
            "quantile"
          ]
        },
        "field": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "predicate": {
          "$ref": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:predicate"
        },
        "interval_start_field": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "interval_end_field": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "available_intervals_ref": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "resource_field": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "amount_field": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "aggregation": {
          "const": "resource-capacity-time"
        },
        "clip_to_window": {
          "const": true
        },
        "outside_availability_policy": {
          "const": "reject"
        },
        "overcapacity_policy": {
          "const": "reject"
        },
        "quantile": {
          "type": "number",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 1
        },
        "quantile_method": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "linear",
            "nearest",
            "lower",
            "higher",
            "midpoint"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "op"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "unit": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "direction": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "maximize",
        "minimize",
        "target"
      ]
    },
    "target": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "value": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "unit": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "value",
        "unit"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "target_deviation": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "kind": {
          "const": "absolute"
        },
        "scale": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "value": {
              "type": "number",
              "exclusiveMinimum": 0
            },
            "unit": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "value",
            "unit"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "kind",
        "scale"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "missing_policy": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "undefined",
        "fail-evaluation"
      ]
    },
    "valid_range": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "lower": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "upper": {
          "type": "number"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "lower",
        "upper"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "implementation_ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "test_fixtures": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1
      },
      "minItems": 1
    },
    "deduplicate_by": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "uniqueItems": true
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schema_id",
    "metric_id",
    "version",
    "label",
    "input_contracts",
    "required_fields",
    "required_complete_contracts",
    "window",
    "reducer",
    "unit",
    "direction",
    "missing_policy",
    "valid_range",
    "implementation_ref",
    "test_fixtures",
    "deduplicate_by"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "allOf": [
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "direction": {
            "const": "target"
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "required": [
          "target",
          "target_deviation"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "reducer": {
            "properties": {
              "op": {
                "const": "fraction"
              }
            }
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "reducer": {
            "required": [
              "predicate"
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "reducer": {
            "properties": {
              "op": {
                "const": "interval-utilization"
              }
            }
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "reducer": {
            "required": [
              "interval_start_field",
              "interval_end_field",
              "available_intervals_ref",
              "resource_field",
              "amount_field",
              "aggregation",
              "clip_to_window",
              "outside_availability_policy",
              "overcapacity_policy"
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "reducer": {
            "properties": {
              "op": {
                "enum": [
                  "sum",
                  "mean",
                  "min",
                  "max",
                  "quantile"
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "reducer": {
            "required": [
              "field"
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "reducer": {
            "properties": {
              "op": {
                "const": "quantile"
              }
            }
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "reducer": {
            "required": [
              "quantile",
              "quantile_method"
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

### C014 模型集成规范 / ModelIntegrationSpec

完整 JSON Schema 2020-12；结构校验之外仍需引用与领域语义校验。

Schema 文件：`model-integration-spec.schema.json`；实例文件：`model-integration-spec.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "schema_id": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:model-integration-spec",
  "model_id": "civil.ephemeris-replay",
  "behavior_version": "1.0.0",
  "manifest_ref": "civil.ephemeris-replay@1.0.0",
  "input_contracts": [
    {
      "contract_id": "input.ephemeris",
      "version": "1.0.0",
      "fields": [
        "tick_ns",
        "position",
        "velocity",
        "frame"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "output_contracts": [
    {
      "contract_id": "orbit.kinematics",
      "version": "1.0.0",
      "fields": [
        "epoch_tick_ns",
        "position",
        "velocity",
        "frame",
        "origin"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "private_state_schema": "civil.ephemeris.private-state@1.0.0",
  "time_mode": "recorded-replay",
  "reads": [
    "input.ephemeris"
  ],
  "read_bindings": [
    {
      "component": "input.ephemeris",
      "asset_selector": "self",
      "source": "continuous-service",
      "contract_ref": "input.ephemeris@1.0.0",
      "producer_instance_id": null
    }
  ],
  "writes": [
    "orbit.kinematics"
  ],
  "units": [
    "m",
    "m/s",
    "s"
  ],
  "frames": [
    "GCRS"
  ],
  "valid_domain": "仅在已冻结星历输入有效区间内；禁止外推",
  "tolerances": [
    {
      "field": "orbit.kinematics.position",
      "absolute": {
        "value": 0.01,
        "unit": "m"
      },
      "relative": 1e-08
    }
  ],
  "determinism_class": "numeric-tolerance",
  "checkpoint_class": "portable-state",
  "failure_policy": "fail-run",
  "resource_budget": {
    "memory_mib": 256,
    "cpu_seconds_per_call": 2,
    "max_output_bytes": 1048576
  },
  "validation_evidence": [
    {
      "fixture_id": "linear-ephemeris",
      "reference_kind": "analytic",
      "expected_result": "给定线性合成星历插值在声明误差内"
    },
    {
```

```json
{
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:predicate",
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "oneOf": [
    {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "op": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "eq",
            "ne",
            "lt",
            "lte",
            "gt",
            "gte"
          ]
        },
        "field": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "value": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "number",
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "op",
        "field",
        "value"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "op": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "all",
            "any"
          ]
        },
        "args": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:predicate"
          },
          "minItems": 1
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "op",
        "args"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "op": {
          "const": "not"
        },
        "arg": {
          "$ref": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:predicate"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "op",
        "arg"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  ]
}
```

### C021 资源容量与可用窗口 / ResourceAvailability

完整 JSON Schema 2020-12；结构校验之外仍需引用与领域语义校验。

#### 实例

```json
[
  {
    "resource_id": "receiver-01",
    "capacity": 1,
    "unit": "1",

      }
    ]
  }

```

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:resource-availability",
  "title": "resource-availability",
  "type": "array",
  "minItems": 1,
  "items": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "resource_id": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
      },
      "capacity": {
        "type": "number",
        "minimum": 0
      },
      "unit": {
        "const": "1"
      },
      "available_intervals": {
        "type": "array",
        "items": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "start_ns": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
              "description": "TAI-relative nanoseconds as decimal string; semantic validator enforces int64 range"
            },
            "end_ns": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
              "description": "TAI-relative nanoseconds as decimal string; semantic validator enforces int64 range"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "start_ns",
            "end_ns"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "minItems": 1
      }
    },
    "required": [
      "resource_id",
      "capacity",
      "unit",
      "available_intervals"
    ],
    "additionalProperties": false
  }
}
```

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:run-policy",
  "title": "run-policy",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:run-policy"
    },
    "profile_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "version": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "inherits": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "replicates": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1
    },
    "max_runs": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1
    },
    "max_parallel": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1
    },
    "cpu_seconds_limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "exclusiveMinimum": 0
    },
    "memory_mib_per_run": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1
    },
    "disk_mib_limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1
    },
    "wall_seconds_per_run": {
      "type": "number",
      "exclusiveMinimum": 0
    },
    "seed_policy": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "master_seed": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$",
          "description": "Unsigned seed decimal; semantic validator enforces 0 <= value <= 18446744073709551615. Not a time quantity."
        },
        "derive_from": {
          "const": [
            "master-seed",
            "seed-block-id",
            "replicate-index",
            "stream-name"
          ]
        },
        "external_random_inputs": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "frozen-dataset",
            "none"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "master_seed",
        "derive_from",
        "external_random_inputs"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "recorded_contracts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "failure_policy": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "retain-failed",
        "stop-batch-on-first-failure"
      ]
    },
    "retry": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "max_attempts": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 100
        },
        "backoff_initial_ms": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 3600000
        },
        "backoff_max_ms": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 3600000
        },
        "retryable_codes": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "TRANSIENT_IO",
              "WORKER_LEASE_LOST",
              "NODE_LOST"
            ]
          },
          "minItems": 0,
          "uniqueItems": true
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "max_attempts",
        "backoff_initial_ms",
        "backoff_max_ms",
        "retryable_codes"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "resume_required": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "offline_inputs_only": {
      "const": true
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schema_id",
    "profile_id",
    "version",
    "inherits",
    "replicates",
    "max_runs",
    "max_parallel",
    "cpu_seconds_limit",
    "memory_mib_per_run",
    "disk_mib_limit",
    "wall_seconds_per_run",
    "seed_policy",
    "recorded_contracts",
    "failure_policy",
    "retry",
    "resume_required",
    "offline_inputs_only"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

```json
                  "target-deviation"
                ]
              },
              "lower": {
                "type": "number"
              },
              "upper": {
                "type": "number"
              },
              "clamp": {
                "type": "boolean"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "kind",
              "clamp"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "allOf": [
              {
                "if": {
                  "properties": {
                    "kind": {
                      "const": "fixed-bounds"
                    }
                  }
                },
                "then": {
                  "required": [
                    "lower",
                    "upper"
                  ]
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "metric_ref",
          "weight",
          "required",
          "normalization"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 1
    },
    "constraints": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "metric_ref": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
          },
          "op": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "lt",
              "lte",
              "eq",
              "gte",
              "gt"
            ]
          },
          "bound": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "value": {
                "type": "number"
              },
              "unit": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "value",
              "unit"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "severity": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "hard",
              "report-only"
            ]
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "metric_ref",
          "op",
          "bound",
          "severity"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 0
    },
    "aggregation": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "weighted-utility",
        "pareto-only"
      ]
    },
    "missing_policy": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "unscorable",
        "partial-renormalize"
      ]
    },
    "failed_run_policy": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "retain-unscorable",
        "declared-penalty"
      ]
    },
    "failure_penalty_utility": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 1
    },
    "censoring_policy": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "retain-separate",
        "complete-windows-only"
      ]
    },
    "comparison_keys": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "uncertainty": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "method": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "none",
            "paired-bootstrap",
            "independent-bootstrap"
          ]
        },
        "confidence_level": {
          "type": "number",
          "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
          "exclusiveMaximum": 1
        },
        "resamples": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1
        },
        "evaluation_seed": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$",
          "description": "Unsigned seed decimal; semantic validator enforces 0 <= value <= 18446744073709551615. Not a time quantity."
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "method",
        "confidence_level",
        "resamples",
        "evaluation_seed"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "pareto_tolerance": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 0
    },
    "pareto_rule": {
      "const": "quantized-utility-origin-zero-exact"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schema_id",
    "profile_id",
    "version",
    "inherits",
    "objectives",
    "constraints",
    "aggregation",
    "missing_policy",
    "failed_run_policy",
    "censoring_policy",
    "comparison_keys",
    "uncertainty",
    "pareto_tolerance",
    "pareto_rule"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "allOf": [
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "failed_run_policy": {
            "const": "declared-penalty"
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "required": [
          "failure_penalty_utility"
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:source-run-manifest",
  "title": "source-run-manifest",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:source-run-manifest"
    },
    "schema_version": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "result_set_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "planned_runs": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1
    },
    "entries": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "run_plan_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "case_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "replicate_index": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 0,
            "maximum": 9007199254740991
          },
          "slot_state": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "queued",
              "running",
              "succeeded",
              "failed",
              "cancelled",
              "skipped"
            ]
          },
          "selected_attempt": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "integer",
                "minimum": 1
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ]
          },
          "attempts": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "run_id": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
                },
                "attempt": {
                  "type": "integer",
                  "minimum": 1
                },
                "state": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": [
                    "queued",
                    "running",
                    "succeeded",
                    "failed",
                    "cancelled"
                  ]
                },
                "manifest_hash": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
                },
                "last_commit_seq": {
                  "anyOf": [
                    {
                      "type": "integer",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 9007199254740991
                    },
                    {
                      "type": "null"
                    }
                  ]
                },
                "reason": {
                  "anyOf": [
                    {
                      "type": "string",
                      "minLength": 1
                    },
                    {
                      "type": "null"
                    }
                  ]
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "run_id",
                "attempt",
                "state",
                "manifest_hash",
                "last_commit_seq",
                "reason"
              ],
              "additionalProperties": false
            },
            "minItems": 0
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "run_plan_id",
          "case_id",
          "replicate_index",
          "slot_state",
          "selected_attempt",
          "attempts"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 1
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schema_id",
    "schema_version",
    "result_set_id",
    "planned_runs",
    "entries"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### C027 窗口裁决载荷 / WindowDecision

完整 JSON Schema 2020-12；结构校验之外仍需引用与领域语义校验。

Schema 文件：`window-decision.schema.json`；实例文件：`window-decision.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "request_id": "request-a",

  "resource_id": "receiver-01",

}
```

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:window-decision",
  "title": "window-decision",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "request_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "accepted": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "amount": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 0
    },
    "resource_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "start_ns": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
      "description": "TAI-relative nanoseconds as decimal string; semantic validator enforces int64 range"
    },
    "end_ns": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
      "description": "TAI-relative nanoseconds as decimal string; semantic validator enforces int64 range"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "request_id",
    "accepted",
    "amount",
    "resource_id",
    "start_ns",
    "end_ns"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "allOf": [
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "accepted": {
            "const": true
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "amount": {
            "exclusiveMinimum": 0
          }
        }
      },
      "else": {
        "properties": {
          "amount": {
            "const": 0
          }
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

```json
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "payloadSchemaId": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "valueType": {
          "enum": [
            "state-record",
            "resource-grant",
            "resource-claim",
            "science-record",
            "equipment-event"
          ]
        },
        "units": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "minItems": 1
        },
        "frame": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "origin": {

          "minLength": 1
        },

        "knowledgeDomain": {

          },
```

### C029 1.2 · 姿态状态载荷 / attitude-state

修订 1.2 的独立契约；结构校验与权限、时序语义检查分别执行。

Schema 文件：`revision12/model_composition/schemas/attitude-state.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision12/model_composition/examples/attitude-state.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "1.0.0",
  "tickNs": "0",
  "frame": "GCRS",
  "bodyFrame": "body",
  "quaternionOrder": "xyzw",
  "quaternion": [
    0,
    0,
    0,
    1
  ]
}
```

### C030 1.2 · 民用模型私有状态 / civil-private-state

修订 1.2 的独立契约；结构校验与权限、时序语义检查分别执行。

Schema 文件：`revision12/model_composition/schemas/civil-private-state.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision12/model_composition/examples/civil-private-state.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "1.0.0",
  "instanceId": "sat-alpha/payloads/optical-camera",
  "lastSampleNs": "0",
  "sampleCount": "0",
  "rngStreamRef": "private/sat-alpha/payloads/optical-camera/v1"
}
```

### C031 1.2 · 组合模型蓝图 / composite-blueprint

修订 1.2 的独立契约；结构校验与权限、时序语义检查分别执行。

Schema 文件：`revision12/model_composition/schemas/composite-blueprint.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision12/model_composition/examples/composite-blueprint.json`

### C032 1.2 · 组合模型检查点 / composite-snapshot

修订 1.2 的独立契约；结构校验与权限、时序语义检查分别执行。

Schema 文件：`revision12/model_composition/schemas/composite-snapshot.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision12/model_composition/examples/composite-snapshot.json`

### C033 1.2 · 设备可用状态 / equipment-status

修订 1.2 的独立契约；结构校验与权限、时序语义检查分别执行。

Schema 文件：`revision12/model_composition/schemas/equipment-status.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision12/model_composition/examples/equipment-status.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "1.0.0",
  "tickNs": "1200000000000",
  "eventId": "offline-001",
  "kind": "civil.equipment.offline",
  "equipmentInstanceId": "sat-alpha/platform/power",
  "reason": "synthetic-test",
  "status": "offline"
}
```

```json
              "ordering",
              "rollbackScope"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "minItems": 0
        },
        "faultPropagation": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "requiredChildFailure": {
              "const": "parent-not-ready-rollback-claims"
            },
            "optionalChildFailure": {
              "const": "mark-unavailable-no-rebind"
            },
            "unavailableRead": {
              "const": "explicit-invalid-no-zero-fill"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "requiredChildFailure",
            "optionalChildFailure",
            "unavailableRead"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "nestedLimits": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "maxDepth": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 1,
              "maximum": 16
            },
            "maxExpandedNodes": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 1,
              "maximum": 100000
            },
            "maxChildrenPerNode": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 1,
              "maximum": 10000
            },
            "preExpandCheckedProduct": {
              "const": true
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "maxDepth",
            "maxExpandedNodes",
            "maxChildrenPerNode",
            "preExpandCheckedProduct"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "lifecycle": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "initialize": {
              "const": "zero-delay-topological-order"
            },
            "readyBarrier": {
              "const": "all-required-children-ready"
            },
            "close": {
              "const": "reverse-successful-initialization-order"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "initialize",
            "readyBarrier",
            "close"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "identityPolicy": {
          "const": "parent-id/declared-child-id"
        },
        "flattening": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "equivalence": {
              "const": "same-components-events-claims-rng-after-id-normalization"
            },
            "checkpoint": {
              "const": "entire-subtree-same-commit"
            },
            "noDuplicateOwners": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "minItems": 1
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "equivalence",
            "checkpoint",
            "noDuplicateOwners"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "schemaId",
        "schemaVersion",
        "artifactStatus",
        "blueprintId",
        "blueprintVersion",
        "slots",
        "children",
        "parameters",
        "parameterMappings",
        "internalConnections",
        "exportedPorts",
        "resourceArbitration",
        "faultPropagation",
        "nestedLimits",
        "lifecycle",
        "identityPolicy",
        "flattening"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  }
}
```

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:experiment-lock-v12-envelope",
  "title": "ExperimentLockV12Envelope",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schemaId": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:experiment-lock-v12-envelope"
    },
    "schemaVersion": {
      "const": "1.2.0"
    },
    "artifactStatus": {
      "const": "design-only"
    },
    "envelopeId": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
    },
    "coreExperimentLockRef": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
    },
    "scenarioExtensionRef": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
    },
    "extensionClosure": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/ClosureItem"
      },
      "minItems": 1
    },
    "closureStatus": {
      "const": "design-fixture-unresolved"
    },
    "extensionRootHash": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$"
    },
    "physicalCausalExtensionHash": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$"
    },
    "evaluationExtensionHash": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$"
    },
    "viewExtensionHash": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$"
    },
    "canonicalizerVersion": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "legacyCoreUnchanged": {
      "const": true
    },
    "resolutionEvidenceRef": {
      "type": "null"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schemaId",
    "schemaVersion",
    "artifactStatus",
    "envelopeId",
    "coreExperimentLockRef",
    "scenarioExtensionRef",
    "extensionClosure",
    "closureStatus",
    "extensionRootHash",
    "physicalCausalExtensionHash",
    "evaluationExtensionHash",
    "viewExtensionHash",
    "canonicalizerVersion",
    "legacyCoreUnchanged",
    "resolutionEvidenceRef"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$defs": {
    "FrozenRef": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "version": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "contentHash": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$"
        },
        "availability": {
          "enum": [
            "synthetic-unresolved",
            "frozen-local"
          ]
        },
        "schemaId": {

            }
          },

            "maxExpandedNodes",

            "preExpandCheckedProduct"
          ],

        },
        "lifecycle": {
          "type": "object",

            },
            "readyBarrier": {
              "const": "all-required-children-ready"
            },
            "close": {
              "const": "reverse-successful-initialization-order"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "initialize",
            "readyBarrier",
            "close"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "identityPolicy": {
          "const": "parent-id/declared-child-id"
        },
        "flattening": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {

            },
            "checkpoint": {
              "const": "entire-subtree-same-commit"
            },
            "noDuplicateOwners": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "minItems": 1
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "equivalence",
            "checkpoint",
            "noDuplicateOwners"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "schemaId",
        "schemaVersion",
        "artifactStatus",
        "blueprintId",
        "blueprintVersion",
        "slots",
        "children",
        "parameters",
        "parameterMappings",
        "internalConnections",
        "exportedPorts",
        "resourceArbitration",
        "faultPropagation",
        "nestedLimits",
        "lifecycle",
        "identityPolicy",
        "flattening"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  }
}
```

### C035 1.2 · 原子模型扩展清单 / model-extension-manifest

修订 1.2 的独立契约；结构校验与权限、时序语义检查分别执行。

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:model-extension-manifest",
  "title": "ModelExtensionManifest",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schemaId": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:model-extension-manifest"
    },
    "schemaVersion": {
      "const": "1.2.0"
    },
    "artifactStatus": {
      "const": "design-only"
    },
    "modelId": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
    },
    "modelVersion": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "category": {
      "const": "civilian-passive"
    },
    "packageRef": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
    },
    "existingPackageManifestRef": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
    },
    "ports": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/Port"
      },
      "minItems": 1
    },
    "requires": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/Capability"
      },
      "minItems": 0
    },
    "provides": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/Capability"
      },
      "minItems": 0
    },
    "parameters": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/Parameter"
      },
      "minItems": 0
    },
    "internalDependencies": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/Dependency"
      },
      "minItems": 0
    },
    "sharedResourceClaims": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/Claim"
      },
      "minItems": 0
    },
    "eventSubscriptions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/EventSub"
      },
      "minItems": 0
    },
    "compatibility": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/Compatibility"
    },
    "privateStateSchemaRef": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
    },
    "migrationPolicy": {
      "const": "explicit-migrator-new-branch"
    },
    "conformanceCases": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1
      },
      "minItems": 1
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schemaId",
    "schemaVersion",
    "artifactStatus",
    "modelId",
    "modelVersion",
    "category",
    "packageRef",
    "existingPackageManifestRef",
    "ports",
    "requires",
    "provides",
    "parameters",
    "internalDependencies",
    "sharedResourceClaims",
    "eventSubscriptions",
    "compatibility",
    "privateStateSchemaRef",
    "migrationPolicy",
    "conformanceCases"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$defs": {
    "FrozenRef": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "version": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "contentHash": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$"
        },
        "availability": {
          "enum": [
            "synthetic-unresolved",
            "frozen-local"
          ]
        },
        "schemaId": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "id",
        "version",
        "contentHash",
        "availability"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "Endpoint": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "instanceId": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "portId": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "instanceId",
        "portId"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "SymbolicEndpoint": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "childPath": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "portId": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "childPath",
        "portId"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "Cardinality": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "necessity": {
          "enum": [
            "required",
            "optional"
          ]
        },
        "multiplicity": {
          "enum": [
            "one",
            "many"
          ]
        },
        "min": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        },
```

### C036 1.2 · 载荷功率申请 / power-claim

修订 1.2 的独立契约；结构校验与权限、时序语义检查分别执行。

Schema 文件：`revision12/model_composition/schemas/power-claim.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision12/model_composition/examples/power-claim.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "1.0.0",
  "tickNs": "0",
  "claimId": "power-claim-001",
  "requestId": "science-request-001",
  "claimantInstanceId": "sat-alpha/payloads/optical-camera",
```

### C037 1.2 · 共享电源状态 / power-resource

修订 1.2 的独立契约；结构校验与权限、时序语义检查分别执行。

Schema 文件：`revision12/model_composition/schemas/power-resource.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision12/model_composition/examples/power-resource.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "1.0.0",
  "tickNs": "0",
  "availableWatts": 120,
  "storedJoules": 720000,
  "resourceId": "sat-alpha/power",
  "authorityInstanceId": "sat-alpha/platform/power"
}
```

### C038 1.2 · 关系重绑定事务 / rebinding-transaction

修订 1.2 的独立契约；结构校验与权限、时序语义检查分别执行。

Schema 文件：`revision12/model_composition/schemas/rebinding-transaction.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision12/model_composition/examples/rebinding-transaction.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "schemaId": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:rebinding-transaction",
  "schemaVersion": "1.2.0",
  "artifactStatus": "design-only",
  "transactionId": "replace-radiometer-design-001",
  "sourceRunEnvelopeRef": {
    "id": "run.civil-science-sat-alpha.synthetic-001",
    "version": "1.0.0",
    "contentHash": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
    "availability": "synthetic-unresolved"
  },
  "sourceCheckpointRef": {
    "id": "checkpoint:sat-alpha-t1200",
    "version": "1.0.0",
    "contentHash": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
    "availability": "synthetic-unresolved"
  },
  "oldBindingRef": {
    "id": "binding.sat-alpha.v1",
    "version": "1.0.0",
    "contentHash": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
    "availability": "synthetic-unresolved"
  },
  "newBindingRef": {
    "id": "binding.sat-alpha.radiometer-v2",
    "version": "1.0.0",
    "contentHash": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
    "availability": "synthetic-unresolved"
  },
  "replacementInstanceId": "sat-alpha/payloads/scientific-radiometer",
  "newModelRef": {
    "id": "civil.payload.scientific-radiometer",
    "version": "2.0.0",
    "contentHash": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
    "availability": "synthetic-unresolved"
  },
  "privateStateMigrationRef": {
    "id": "migration:radiometer-state-1-to-2",
    "version": "1.0.0",
    "contentHash": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
    "availability": "synthetic-unresolved"
  },
  "commitMode": "new-branch-atomic",
  "affectedClosure": [
    "model",
    "binding",
    "execution-graph",
    "writer-map",
    "random-stream-lineage",
    "lock"
  ],
  "failurePolicy": "keep-source-unchanged",
  "requiresCompatibilityReport": true
}
```

### C039 1.2 · 1.2 运行清单外层 / run-manifest-v12-envelope

```json
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "blueprintVersion": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "slots": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {

          },
          "minItems": 1
        },

          "items": {

          },
          "minItems": 1

          },

        },

          "items": {

          },
          "minItems": 0
        },
        "exportedPorts": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Export"
          },
          "minItems": 0
        },
        "resourceArbitration": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "resourceRole": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "authorityChildPath": {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
              },
              "claimSelection": {
                "const": "all-or-nothing-stable-priority"
              },
              "ordering": {
                "const": [
                  "priority-desc",
                  "request-id",
                  "claim-id"
                ]
              },
              "rollbackScope": {
                "const": "whole-parent-initialization"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "resourceRole",
              "authorityChildPath",
              "claimSelection",
              "ordering",
              "rollbackScope"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "minItems": 0
        },
        "faultPropagation": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "requiredChildFailure": {
              "const": "parent-not-ready-rollback-claims"
            },
            "optionalChildFailure": {
              "const": "mark-unavailable-no-rebind"
            },
            "unavailableRead": {
              "const": "explicit-invalid-no-zero-fill"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "requiredChildFailure",
            "optionalChildFailure",
            "unavailableRead"
          ],

        },

            },

              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 1,
              "maximum": 100000
            },
            "maxChildrenPerNode": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 1,
              "maximum": 10000
            },
            "preExpandCheckedProduct": {
              "const": true
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "maxDepth",
            "maxExpandedNodes",
            "maxChildrenPerNode",
            "preExpandCheckedProduct"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "lifecycle": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "initialize": {
              "const": "zero-delay-topological-order"
            },
            "readyBarrier": {
              "const": "all-required-children-ready"
            },
            "close": {
              "const": "reverse-successful-initialization-order"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "initialize",
            "readyBarrier",
            "close"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "identityPolicy": {
          "const": "parent-id/declared-child-id"
        },
        "flattening": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "equivalence": {
              "const": "same-components-events-claims-rng-after-id-normalization"
            },
            "checkpoint": {
              "const": "entire-subtree-same-commit"
            },
            "noDuplicateOwners": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "minItems": 1
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "equivalence",
            "checkpoint",
            "noDuplicateOwners"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "schemaId",
        "schemaVersion",
        "artifactStatus",
        "blueprintId",
        "blueprintVersion",
        "slots",
        "children",
        "parameters",
        "parameterMappings",
        "internalConnections",
        "exportedPorts",
        "resourceArbitration",
        "faultPropagation",
        "nestedLimits",
        "lifecycle",
        "identityPolicy",
        "flattening"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  }
}
```

### C040 1.2 · 场景实例关系绑定 / scenario-binding

修订 1.2 的独立契约；结构校验与权限、时序语义检查分别执行。

### C041 1.2 · 场景扩展清单 / scenario-extension-manifest

修订 1.2 的独立契约；结构校验与权限、时序语义检查分别执行。

Schema 文件：`revision12/model_composition/schemas/scenario-extension-manifest.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision12/model_composition/examples/scenario-extension-manifest.json`

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:scenario-extension-manifest",
  "title": "ScenarioExtensionManifest",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schemaId": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:scenario-extension-manifest"
    },
    "schemaVersion": {
      "const": "1.2.0"
    },
    "artifactStatus": {
      "const": "design-only"
    },
    "extensionId": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
    },
    "scenarioId": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
    },
    "scenarioVersion": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "coreScenarioRef": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
    },
    "baseProfiles": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "conditionsProfile": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
        },
        "dynamicsProfile": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
        },
        "adjudicationProfile": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
        },
        "scoreProfile": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
        },
        "runPolicy": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "conditionsProfile",
        "dynamicsProfile",
        "adjudicationProfile",
        "scoreProfile",
        "runPolicy"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "adjudicationWorkflowProfileRef": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
    },
    "visibilityPolicyRef": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
    },
    "predictionProfileRef": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
    },
    "safetyEventHypothesisRef": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
    },
    "scenarioEventPlanRef": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "themePresetRef": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
    },
    "scienceObservationAdapterRef": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
    },
    "compositeBlueprintRefs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
      },
      "minItems": 1
    },
    "scenarioBindingRef": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/FrozenRef"
    },
    "eventScope": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "enum": [
          "civil.equipment.offline",
          "civil.link.outage",
          "science.task.created"
        ]
      },
      "minItems": 0
    },
    "predictionUse": {
      "enum": [
        "display-only",
        "runtime-decision"
      ]
    },
    "freezePolicy": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "profileResolution": {
          "const": "entire-transitive-closure"
        },
        "includeWorkflowChildProfiles": {
          "const": true
        },
        "unknownFields": {
          "const": "reject"
        },
        "coreDtoMutation": {
          "const": "forbidden"
        },
        "hashMode": {
          "const": "synthetic-placeholders-not-runtime-evidence"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "profileResolution",
        "includeWorkflowChildProfiles",
        "unknownFields",
        "coreDtoMutation",
        "hashMode"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "compatibility": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/Compatibility"
    },
    "scenarioFacts": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {

          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },

          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$"
        },
        "scienceRequestId": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "epochTAI",
        "durationNs",
        "scienceRequestId"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schemaId",

    "artifactStatus",
    "extensionId",

    "predictionUse",
    "freezePolicy",
    "compatibility",
    "scenarioFacts"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$defs": {
    "FrozenRef": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "version": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },

          ]
        },
        "schemaId": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "id",
        "version",
        "contentHash",
        "availability"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "Endpoint": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "instanceId": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "portId": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "instanceId",
        "portId"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "SymbolicEndpoint": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "childPath": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "portId": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "childPath",
        "portId"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "Cardinality": {
```

### C042 1.2 · 内部科学测量 / science-measurement

修订 1.2 的独立契约；结构校验与权限、时序语义检查分别执行。

Schema 文件：`revision12/model_composition/schemas/science-measurement.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision12/model_composition/examples/science-measurement.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "1.0.0",
  "tickNs": "1000000000",
  "measurementId": "science-001",
  "sourceInstanceId": "sat-alpha/payloads/optical-camera",
  "kind": "optical-summary",
  "values": [
    0.4
  ],
  "unit": "1",
  "quality": "valid",
  "knowledgeDomain": "physical-truth",
  "audience": [
    "operator-alpha"
  ]
}
```

### C043 1.2 · 共享存储状态 / storage-resource

修订 1.2 的独立契约；结构校验与权限、时序语义检查分别执行。

Schema 文件：`revision12/model_composition/schemas/storage-resource.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision12/model_composition/examples/storage-resource.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "1.0.0",
  "tickNs": "0",
  "availableBytes": "1000000000",
  "resourceId": "sat-alpha/storage",
  "authorityInstanceId": "sat-alpha/platform/storage"
}
```

#### 完整 Schema

```json

      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$"
    },

      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$"

    },

      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
    }

    "tickNs",
    "availableBytes",
    "resourceId",
    "authorityInstanceId"

  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$defs": {
    "FrozenRef": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "version": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "contentHash": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$"
        },
        "availability": {
          "enum": [
            "synthetic-unresolved",
            "frozen-local"
          ]
        },
        "schemaId": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "id",
        "version",
        "contentHash",
        "availability"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "Endpoint": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "instanceId": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "portId": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
        }
      },
      "required": [

        "portId"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "SymbolicEndpoint": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {

          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "portId": {

          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{0,191}$"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "childPath",
        "portId"
      ],
```

### C044 1.2 · 类型化端口契约 / typed-port-contract

修订 1.2 的独立契约；结构校验与权限、时序语义检查分别执行。

Schema 文件：`revision12/model_composition/schemas/typed-port-contract.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision12/model_composition/examples/typed-port-contract.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "schemaId": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:typed-port-contract",
  "schemaVersion": "1.2.0",
  "artifactStatus": "design-only",
  "port": {
    "portId": "orbit.state",
    "direction": "out",
    "role": "orbit.state",
    "contractVersion": "1.0.0",
    "payloadSchemaId": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:orbit-kinematics",
    "valueType": "state-record",
    "units": [
      "m",
      "m/s"
    ],
    "frame": "GCRS",
    "origin": "earth-center",
    "updateTime": {
      "timeScale": "TAI",
      "sampleMode": "current-tick",
      "periodNs": "1000000000",
      "maxAgeNs": "1000000000",
      "timeField": "epoch_tick_ns"
    },
    "knowledgeDomain": "physical-truth",
    "audience": [
      "operator-alpha"
    ],
    "cardinality": {
      "necessity": "required",
      "multiplicity": "one",
      "min": 1,
      "max": 1
    },
    "failurePolicy": "fail-run",
    "stateAccess": "single-writer",
    "componentKey": "orbit.kinematics"
  }
}
```

### C045 1.2 · 感知与裁决工作流 / adjudication-workflow-profile

修订 1.2 的独立契约；结构校验与权限、时序语义检查分别执行。

Schema 文件：`revision12/schemas/adjudication-workflow-profile.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision12/examples/adjudication-workflow-profile.json`

#### 实例

```json
{

      "semantics": "current-stage",
      "delay_ns": "0"

  "runtime_prediction_ref": null,
  "simulated_sharing_ref": "sharing.science-private@1.0.0"
}
```
