#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:adjudication-workflow-profile",
  "title": "adjudication-workflow-profile",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:adjudication-workflow-profile"
    },
    "object_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "version": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "omniscient-baseline",
        "sensed-immediate",
        "sensed-delayed"
      ]
    },
    "profiles": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "observation_profile": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "delivery_profile": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "knowledge_policy": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "visibility_policy": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "outcome_rules": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "rule_editing_policy": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "observation_profile",
        "delivery_profile",
        "knowledge_policy",
        "visibility_policy",
        "outcome_rules",
        "rule_editing_policy"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "evidence_basis": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "truth-baseline",
        "party-knowledge",
        "approved-shared-knowledge"
      ]
    },
    "nodes": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "node_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "kind": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "truth-projector",
              "observation",
              "delivery",
              "knowledge-admission",
              "prediction",
              "adjudication",
              "offline-evaluation"
            ]
          },
          "implementation_ref": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
          },
          "phase": {
            "type": "integer",
            "enum": [
              10,
              20,
              30,
              40
            ]
          },
          "input_domain": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "truth-restricted",
              "generated-observation",
              "delivery",
              "party-knowledge",
              "approved-shared-knowledge",
              "baseline-evidence"
            ]
          },
          "output_domain": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "generated-observation",
              "delivery",
              "party-knowledge",
              "decision",
              "restricted-evaluation",
              "baseline-evidence"
            ]
          },
          "party_id": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ]
          },
          "approved_release_ref": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ]
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "node_id",
          "kind",
          "implementation_ref",
          "phase",
          "input_domain",
          "output_domain",
          "party_id",
          "approved_release_ref"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 64
    },
    "edges": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "source_node": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "target_node": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "semantics": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "current-stage",
              "previous-commit",
              "positive-delay"
            ]
          },
          "delay_ns": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
            "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "source_node",
          "target_node",
          "semantics",
          "delay_ns"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 0,
      "maxItems": 128
    },
    "max_microsteps": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1
    },
    "runtime_prediction_ref": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "simulated_sharing_ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schema_id",
    "object_id",
    "version",
    "mode",
    "profiles",
    "evidence_basis",
    "nodes",
    "edges",
    "max_microsteps",
    "runtime_prediction_ref",
    "simulated_sharing_ref"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:delivery-profile",
  "title": "delivery-profile",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:delivery-profile"
    },
    "object_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "version": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "latency_kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "zero",
        "fixed",
        "bounded-distribution"
      ]
    },
    "latency_ns": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
      "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
    },
    "distribution_ref": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "recipient_party_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 32,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "loss_policy_ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "ordering": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "source-order",
        "allow-reordering"
      ]
    },
    "max_pending": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1
    },
    "max_fanout": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schema_id",
    "object_id",
    "version",
    "latency_kind",
    "latency_ns",
    "distribution_ref",
    "recipient_party_ids",
    "loss_policy_ref",
    "ordering",
    "max_pending",
    "max_fanout"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "allOf": [
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "latency_kind": {
            "const": "zero"
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "latency_ns": {
            "const": "0"
          },
          "distribution_ref": {
            "type": "null"
          }
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "latency_kind": {
            "const": "fixed"
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "distribution_ref": {
            "type": "null"
          }
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "latency_kind": {
            "const": "bounded-distribution"
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "distribution_ref": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
          },
          "latency_ns": {
            "const": "0"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

Schema 文件：`revision12/schemas/evaluation-coverage-certificate.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision12/examples/evaluation-coverage-certificate.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "schema_id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:evaluation-coverage-certificate",

  "hypothesis_hash": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",

  "method": "not-evaluated",
  "window": {
    "start_ns": "0",
    "end_ns": "3600000000000"
  },
  "object_set_hash": "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb",
  "geometry_hash": "cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc",
  "resolution_ns": "0",
  "gaps": [],
  "observed_event_count": null,
  "log_complete": true,
  "continuous_absence_claim": false
}
```

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:evaluation-coverage-certificate",
  "title": "evaluation-coverage-certificate",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:evaluation-coverage-certificate"
    },
    "detector_ref": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "hypothesis_hash": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
    },
    "evaluation_status": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "not-evaluated",
        "complete-to-method",
        "partial",
        "failed"
      ]
    },
    "method": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "not-evaluated",
        "sampled",
        "continuous"
      ]
    },
    "window": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "start_ns": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
          "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
        },
        "end_ns": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
          "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "start_ns",
        "end_ns"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "object_set_hash": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
    },
    "geometry_hash": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
    },
    "resolution_ns": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
      "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
    },
    "gaps": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "start_ns": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
            "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
          },
          "end_ns": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
            "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "start_ns",
          "end_ns"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 0,
      "maxItems": 256
    },
    "observed_event_count": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "log_complete": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "continuous_absence_claim": {
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schema_id",
    "detector_ref",
    "hypothesis_hash",
    "evaluation_status",
    "method",
    "window",
    "object_set_hash",
    "geometry_hash",
    "resolution_ns",
    "gaps",
    "observed_event_count",
    "log_complete",
    "continuous_absence_claim"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "allOf": [
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "evaluation_status": {
            "const": "not-evaluated"
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "method": {
            "const": "not-evaluated"
          },
          "observed_event_count": {
            "type": "null"
          },
          "continuous_absence_claim": {
            "const": false
          }
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "method": {
            "const": "sampled"
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "continuous_absence_claim": {
            "const": false
          }
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "continuous_absence_claim": {
            "const": true
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "evaluation_status": {
            "const": "complete-to-method"
          },
          "method": {
            "const": "continuous"
          },
          "observed_event_count": {
            "const": 0
          },
          "gaps": {
            "maxItems": 0
          },
          "detector_ref": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
          },
          "log_complete": {
            "const": true
          }
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

### C055 1.2 · 知识策略 / knowledge-policy

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:knowledge-policy",
  "title": "knowledge-policy",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:knowledge-policy"
    },
    "object_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "version": {
      "type": "string",

    },

      "type": "string",

      ]

    "knowledge_owner": {
      "type": "string",

}
```

Schema 文件：`revision12/schemas/scenario-event-plan.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision12/examples/scenario-event-plan.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "schema_id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:scenario-event-plan",
  "object_id": "platform-outage-demo",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "capability_ref": "civil.platform.temporary-unavailable@1.0.0",
  "target_model_path": "event-demo/platform",
  "target_asset_id": "event-demo",
  "payload_schema": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:temporary-unavailable-payload",
  "payload": {
    "duration_ns": "5000000000"
  },
  "trigger": {
    "kind": "scheduled",
    "at_tick_ns": "20000000000"
  },
  "recovery_ref": "civil.handler.remove-availability-cause@1.0.0",
  "notification_policy_ref": "delivery.platform-alert-delayed@1.0.0",
  "budget": {
    "max_occurrences": 1,
    "max_pending": 4,
    "max_fanout": 2,
    "expiry_ns": "60000000000"
  },
  "visibility": "scenario-authority-only-until-authorized-delivery"
}
```

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:scenario-event-plan",
  "title": "scenario-event-plan",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:scenario-event-plan"
    },
    "object_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "version": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "capability_ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "target_model_path": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*(/[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)*$"
    },
    "target_asset_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "payload_schema": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 256
    },
    "payload": {
      "type": "object"
    },
    "trigger": {
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "kind": {
              "const": "scheduled"
            },
            "at_tick_ns": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
              "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "kind",
            "at_tick_ns"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "kind": {
              "const": "condition"
            },
            "predicate_ref": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
            },
            "basis": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": [
                "truth-restricted",
                "party-knowledge"
              ]
            },
            "evaluation_cadence_ns": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
              "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
            },
            "min_separation_ns": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
              "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
            },
            "max_occurrences": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 1
            },
            "acting_party_id": {
              "anyOf": [
                {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
                },
                {
                  "type": "null"
                }
              ]
            },
            "knowledge_policy_ref": {
              "anyOf": [
                {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
                },
                {
                  "type": "null"
                }
              ]
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "kind",
            "predicate_ref",
            "basis",
            "evaluation_cadence_ns",
            "min_separation_ns",
            "max_occurrences",
            "acting_party_id",
            "knowledge_policy_ref"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false,
          "allOf": [
            {
              "if": {
                "properties": {
                  "basis": {
                    "const": "party-knowledge"
                  }
                }
              },
              "then": {
                "properties": {
                  "acting_party_id": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
                  },
                  "knowledge_policy_ref": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
                  }
                }
              },
              "else": {
                "properties": {
                  "acting_party_id": {
                    "type": "null"
                  },
                  "knowledge_policy_ref": {
                    "type": "null"
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "kind": {
              "const": "stochastic"
            },
            "distribution_ref": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
            },
            "window": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "start_ns": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
                  "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
                },
                "end_ns": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
                  "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "start_ns",
                "end_ns"
              ],
              "additionalProperties": false
            },
            "event_count": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 1
            },
            "randomness_namespace": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
            },
            "action_independent": {
              "type": "boolean"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "kind",
            "distribution_ref",
            "window",
            "event_count",
            "randomness_namespace",
            "action_independent"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      ]
    },
    "recovery_ref": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "notification_policy_ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "budget": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "max_occurrences": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1
        },
        "max_pending": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1
        },
        "max_fanout": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1
        },
        "expiry_ns": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
          "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "max_occurrences",
        "max_pending",
        "max_fanout",
        "expiry_ns"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "visibility": {
      "const": "scenario-authority-only-until-authorized-delivery"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schema_id",
    "object_id",
    "version",
    "capability_ref",
    "target_model_path",
    "target_asset_id",
    "payload_schema",
    "payload",
    "trigger",
    "recovery_ref",
    "notification_policy_ref",
    "budget",
    "visibility"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:scoped-result-manifest",
  "title": "scoped-result-manifest",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:scoped-result-manifest"
    },
    "manifest_handle": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
    },
    "population_scope": {
      "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
      "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:population-scope",
      "title": "population-scope",
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "schema_id": {
          "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:population-scope"
        },
        "scope_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
        },
        "purpose": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 256
        },
        "policy_ref": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "entitlement_revision": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
        },
        "authorized_run_handles": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
          },
          "minItems": 0,
          "maxItems": 1000,
          "uniqueItems": true
        },
        "planned_within_scope": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "manifest_handle": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
        },
        "completeness_semantics": {
          "const": "within-authorized-scope"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "schema_id",
        "scope_id",
        "purpose",
        "policy_ref",
        "entitlement_revision",
        "authorized_run_handles",
        "planned_within_scope",
        "manifest_handle",
        "completeness_semantics"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "slots": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "logical_run_handle": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
          },
          "status": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "planned",
              "running",
              "completed",
              "failed",
              "cancelled"
            ]
          },
          "attempt_handles": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
            },
            "minItems": 0,
            "maxItems": 100
          },
          "selected_terminal_attempt": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ]
          },
          "metrics": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "metric_id": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
                },
                "value": {
                  "anyOf": [
                    {
                      "type": "number"
                    },
                    {
                      "type": "null"
                    }
                  ]
                },
                "unit": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "minLength": 1,
                  "maxLength": 256
                },
                "quality": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": [
                    "valid",
                    "undefined",
                    "not-applicable",
                    "incomplete"
                  ]
                },
                "reason": {
                  "anyOf": [
                    {
                      "type": "string",
                      "minLength": 1,
                      "maxLength": 256
                    },
                    {
                      "type": "null"
                    }
                  ]
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "metric_id",
                "value",
                "unit",
                "quality",
                "reason"
              ],
              "additionalProperties": false,
              "allOf": [
                {
                  "if": {
                    "properties": {
                      "quality": {
                        "const": "valid"
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  "then": {
                    "properties": {
                      "value": {
                        "type": "number"
                      }
                    }
                  }
                },
                {
                  "if": {
                    "properties": {
                      "quality": {
                        "enum": [
                          "undefined",
                          "not-applicable"
                        ]
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  "then": {
                    "properties": {
                      "value": {
                        "type": "null"
                      },
                      "reason": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "minLength": 1,
                        "maxLength": 256
                      }
                    }
                  }
                },
                {
                  "if": {
                    "properties": {
                      "quality": {
                        "const": "incomplete"
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  "then": {
                    "properties": {
                      "reason": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "minLength": 1,
                        "maxLength": 256
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }
              ]
            },
            "minItems": 0,
            "maxItems": 128
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "logical_run_handle",
          "status",
          "attempt_handles",
          "selected_terminal_attempt",
          "metrics"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 0,
      "maxItems": 1000
    },
    "complete_within_scope": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "scope_digest": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
    },
    "evidence_basis": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "party-knowledge",
        "approved-shared-knowledge",
        "truth-baseline"
      ]
    },
    "release_profile_ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "evaluation_handle": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
    },
    "evaluation_scope_digest": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
    },
    "source_scope_snapshot_handle": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
    },
    "source_scope_snapshot_digest": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
    },
    "score_profile_ref": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "handle": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
        },
        "version": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "scope_digest": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        }
      },
      "required": [
```

### C079 1.2 · 临时不可用事件载荷 / temporary-unavailable-payload

修订 1.2 的独立契约；结构校验与权限、时序语义检查分别执行。

Schema 文件：`revision12/schemas/temporary-unavailable-payload.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision12/examples/temporary-unavailable-payload.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "duration_ns": "5000000000"
}
```

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:temporary-unavailable-payload",
  "title": "temporary-unavailable-payload",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "duration_ns": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
      "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"

  },
  "required": [
    "duration_ns"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### C081 1.3 · apply-receipt

Durable acceptance/effect receipt, not a claim that an asynchronous job finished. Retry returns same effect_id and immutable artifact refs. Stop is irreversible; there is no undo-stop operation.

Schema 文件：`revision13/contracts/schemas/apply-receipt.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision13/contracts/examples/apply-receipt.json`

```json
{

  "request_id": "request-01",

  "project_id": "project-civil-lab",

  "preflight_report_id": "preflight-01",
  "approval_decision_id": "approval-01",
  "effect_id": "effect-01",
  "status": "applied",
  "original_receipt_id": null,

    {
      "artifact_kind": "draft-revision",

      "target": {
```

```json
            "type": "string",

        ],
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "allOf": [
          {
            "if": {

            },

                        "object_id",
                        "project_id"
                      ],

                    },
                    {
```

### C082 1.3 · apply-request

UI, Agent and CLI share one application-service commit protocol. Authenticated actor identity is supplied only by the trusted transport/session, never by a client principal field. Requested context is intent, never authority. Idempotency ledger key is tenant/project/principal/action/key; a reused key with a different semantic request is rejected.

Schema 文件：`revision13/contracts/schemas/apply-request.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision13/contracts/examples/apply-request.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "schema_id": "urn:space-sim:design:v13:apply-request",
  "request_id": "request-01",
  "idempotency_key": "apply_draft_idempotency_000001",
  "project_id": "project-civil-lab",
  "client_origin": "ui",
  "context_manifest_id": "context-01",
  "requested_context": {
    "session_id": "session-01",
    "agent_task_id": "agent-task-01",
    "target": {
      "kind": "scenario-draft",
      "object_id": "draft-civil-hour",
      "project_id": "project-civil-lab"
    },
    "perspective": "authorized-knowledge",
    "purpose": "civil-planning",
    "knowledge_cursor": "authorized_knowledge_cursor_001"
  },
  "change_set_id": "change-01",
  "change_hash": "17be8dca88bb771bc33d136257dde15e51f0258275c1ee699b99bfba4b88d56f",
  "preflight_report_id": "preflight-01",
  "preflight_hash": "2a54212c528c8f7ced52bd3d61687f66a4dc950b889700daddc7fc4442be68d8",
  "approval_decision_id": "approval-01"
}
```

### C084 1.3 · change-set

Typed proposal only. Per-action strict parameters and operation variants prohibit arbitrary patches, scripts or JSON-pointer evaluation. Hash covers every field except change_hash; exact base revision and immutable source hashes are mandatory. draft.save cannot conceal restore_revision.

### C085 1.3 · context-manifest

Server-issued scope snapshot, never a client authority claim. v12 knowledge_cursor and population scope are opaque, party/purpose/cutoff/policy bound; current entitlement must be rechecked. Signature verification and revocation are not provided by JSON Schema.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v13:context-manifest",
  "title": "context-manifest",

  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v13:context-manifest"
    },
    "manifest_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "issuer": {
      "const": "authenticated-application-service"
    },

      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"

      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"

            "type": "string",
            "enum": [

              "run-attempt",
              "rule-set",
              "result-manifest"
            ]
          },

            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          },

            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "kind",
          "object_id",
          "project_id"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 64,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "artifact_refs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "artifact_kind": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "draft-revision",

              "run-plan",
              "run-manifest",

          "artifact_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          },

            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          },

            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
```

### C086 1.3 · preflight-report

Immutable server preflight of one exact proposal and resource reservation basis. dependency_closure/hash cover authorized scope only; opaque full_dependency_closure_handle binds the exact full server-resolved closure without leaking hidden hashes or counts. Ready is not execution. Any changed closure, budget, policy, base, or expiry requires new preflight.

Schema 文件：`revision13/contracts/schemas/preflight-report.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision13/contracts/examples/preflight-report.json`

#### 实例

```json

  "context_manifest_id": "context-01",

  "principal_id": "user-scientist",
  "action": "draft.save",
  "target": {
    "kind": "scenario-draft",
    "object_id": "draft-civil-hour",
    "project_id": "project-civil-lab"
  },
```

### C087 1.3 · workspace-snapshot

Presentation restoration intent only. No ContextManifest, approval, tokens, cursor, PTY connection, browser cookies, arbitrary URLs, transcript-derived state or authoritative cached result. Reauthorize every restored reference and requery current status; missing objects become placeholders, not implicit creates.

Schema 文件：`revision13/contracts/schemas/workspace-snapshot.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision13/contracts/examples/workspace-snapshot.json`

### C088 1.3 · workspace-state

Authorized bounded lifecycle graph, not the global database. AgentTask is application work, never a civil MissionTask. Existing v1/v12 locks and run_id retain their meaning. Referential integrity, object ownership, lifecycle and immutable history require semantic validation.

Schema 文件：`revision13/contracts/schemas/workspace-state.schema.json`；实例文件：`revision13/contracts/examples/workspace-state.json`

```json
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v13:workspace-state",
  "title": "workspace-state",
  "description": "Authorized bounded lifecycle graph, not the global database. AgentTask is application work, never a civil MissionTask. Existing v1/v12 locks and run_id retain their meaning. Referential integrity, object ownership, lifecycle and immutable history require semantic validation.",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v13:workspace-state"
    },
    "project": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "project_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
        },
        "tenant_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
        },
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 512
        },
        "status": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "active",
            "archived"
          ]
        },
        "revision": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "project_id",
        "tenant_id",
        "name",
        "status",
        "revision"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
```

### C089 MCP  · 创建民用实验草案 · 输入

组合已批准模板、条件、动力学、裁决、评分和运行策略。只接受注册参数与已导入的项目数据 ID；不运行仿真。草案默认保留 30 天，准确到期时间见返回值。 此处为工具输入契约。

Schema 文件：`sim_create_draft-input.schema.json`；实例文件：`sim_create_draft-input.example.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "idempotency_key": "draft-demo-key-0001",
  "draft": {
    "schema_version": "1.0.0",
    "project_id": "proj_civil_demo",
    "name": "民用科学观测窗口与存储可用性实验",
    "purpose": "civilian_observation",
    "template_ref": {
      "object_id": "template_eo_demo",
      "version": "1.0.0",
      "content_hash": "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
    },
    "conditions_profile_ref": {
      "object_id": "conditions_synthetic",
      "version": "1.0.0",
      "content_hash": "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
    },
    "dynamics_profile_ref": {
      "object_id": "dynamics_passive",
      "version": "1.0.0",
      "content_hash": "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
    },
    "adjudication_profile_ref": {
      "object_id": "adjudication_availability",
      "version": "1.0.0",
      "content_hash": "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
    },
    "score_profile_ref": {
      "object_id": "score_coverage",
      "version": "1.0.0",
      "content_hash": "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
    },
    "run_policy_ref": {
      "object_id": "policy_offline_demo",
      "version": "1.0.0",
      "content_hash": "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
    },
    "parameter_bindings": [],
    "sweep_axes": [
      {
        "profile": "conditions",
        "parameter_id": "weather.cloud_fraction",
        "values": [
          0.1,
          0.3
        ]
      }
    ],
    "seed_plan": {
      "master_seed": "42",
      "seed_block_id": "paired_observation_demo",
      "replicate_count": 3
    },
    "input_artifact_ids": [
      "artifact_synthetic_ephemeris"
    ]
  }
}
```

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "idempotency_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 16,
      "maxLength": 128,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$"
    },
    "draft": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/DraftSpec"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "idempotency_key",
    "draft"
  ],
  "$defs": {
    "Binding": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "profile": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "conditions",
            "dynamics",
            "adjudication"
          ]
        },
        "parameter_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 128,
          "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9_.]*$"
        },
        "value": {
          "oneOf": [
            {
              "type": "number",
              "minimum": -1000000000000000.0,
              "maximum": 1000000000000000.0
            },
            {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 0,
              "maxLength": 256
            },
            {
              "type": "boolean"
            }
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "profile",
        "parameter_id",
        "value"
      ]
    },
    "DraftSpec": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "schema_version": {
          "const": "1.0.0"
        },
        "project_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 3,
          "maxLength": 128,
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
        },
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 120
        },
        "purpose": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "civilian_resource_availability",
            "civilian_observation"
          ]
        },
        "description": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 0,
          "maxLength": 2000
        },
        "template_ref": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ObjectRef"
        },
        "conditions_profile_ref": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ObjectRef"
        },
        "dynamics_profile_ref": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ObjectRef"
        },
        "adjudication_profile_ref": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ObjectRef"
        },
        "score_profile_ref": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ObjectRef"
        },
        "run_policy_ref": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ObjectRef"
        },
        "parameter_bindings": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Binding"
          },
          "minItems": 0,
          "maxItems": 256
        },
        "sweep_axes": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/SweepAxis"
          },
          "minItems": 0,
          "maxItems": 16
        },
        "seed_plan": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SeedPlan"
        },
        "input_artifact_ids": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 3,
            "maxLength": 128,
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
          },
          "minItems": 0,
          "maxItems": 256,
          "uniqueItems": true
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "schema_version",
        "project_id",
        "name",
        "purpose",
        "template_ref",
        "conditions_profile_ref",
        "dynamics_profile_ref",
        "adjudication_profile_ref",
        "score_profile_ref",
        "run_policy_ref",
        "parameter_bindings",
        "sweep_axes",
        "seed_plan",
        "input_artifact_ids"
      ]
    },
    "ObjectRef": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "object_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 3,
          "maxLength": 128,
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
        },
        "version": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 5,
          "maxLength": 64,
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "content_hash": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 71,
          "maxLength": 71,
          "pattern": "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "object_id",
        "version",
        "content_hash"
      ]
    },
    "SeedPlan": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "master_seed": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 20,
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$"
        },
        "seed_block_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 3,
          "maxLength": 128,
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
        },
        "replicate_count": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 1024
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "master_seed",
        "seed_block_id",
        "replicate_count"
      ]
    },
    "SweepAxis": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "profile": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "conditions",
            "dynamics",
            "adjudication"
          ]
        },
        "parameter_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 128,
          "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9_.]*$"
        },
        "values": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "oneOf": [
              {
                "type": "number",
                "minimum": -1000000000000000.0,
                "maximum": 1000000000000000.0
              },
              {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 0,
                "maxLength": 256
              },
              {
                "type": "boolean"
              }
            ]
          },
          "minItems": 1,
          "maxItems": 100,
          "uniqueItems": true
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "profile",
        "parameter_id",
        "values"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

```json
}
```

```json
{

      "type": "string",

      "maxLength": 128,
```

### C097 MCP  · 请求停止作业 · 输入

协作式取消；停止新任务，在提交边界结束正在运行的任务并保留已提交数据。不删除数据；成功回执不代表全部 worker 已停止。终态保持不变。 此处为工具输入契约。

Schema 文件：`sim_cancel_job-input.schema.json`；实例文件：`sim_cancel_job-input.example.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "project_id": "proj_civil_demo",
  "job_id": "job_demo_batch",
  "reason": "user_requested",
  "idempotency_key": "cancel-demo-key-01"
}
```

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "project_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 3,
      "maxLength": 128,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
    },
    "job_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 3,
      "maxLength": 128,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
    },
    "reason": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "user_requested",
        "budget_concern",
        "superseded"
      ]
    },
    "idempotency_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 16,
      "maxLength": 128,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "project_id",
    "job_id",
    "reason",
    "idempotency_key"
  ]
}
```

### C099 MCP  · 读取结果快照 · 输入

读取不可变结果快照分页；运行中结果必须显式允许 partial。返回快照 ID 与内容摘要，供离线重评分。仅返回已提交记录和授权资源 URI。 此处为工具输入契约。

Schema 文件：`sim_get_results-input.schema.json`；实例文件：`sim_get_results-input.example.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "project_id": "proj_civil_demo",
  "job_id": "job_demo_batch",
  "allow_partial": false,
  "page_size": 100
}
```

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "project_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 3,
      "maxLength": 128,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
    },
    "job_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 3,
      "maxLength": 128,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
    },
    "allow_partial": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": false
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 8,
      "maxLength": 2048
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "project_id",
    "job_id",
    "allow_partial",
    "page_size"
  ]
}
```

```json
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "experiment_lock_hash",

        "score_profile_ref",

        "scorer_digest",

        },
        "diagnostics": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Diagnostic"
          },
          "minItems": 0,
          "maxItems": 100
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "run_id",
        "attempt",
        "state",
        "complete",
        "metrics",
        "provenance",
        "artifacts",
        "diagnostics"
      ]
    },
    "RunCounts": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,

        "planned": {
          "type": "integer",

          "maximum": 10000
        },

          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 10000
        },
        "running": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 10000
        },
        "succeeded": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 10000
        },
        "failed": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 10000
        },
        "cancelled": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 10000
        },
        "skipped": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 10000
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "planned",
        "queued",
        "running",
        "succeeded",
        "failed",
        "cancelled",
        "skipped"
      ]
    },
    "RunSeedPlan": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,

        "master_seed": {

          "maxLength": 20,
```

### C101 MCP  · 离线重算版本化指标 · 输入

仅读取指定不可变结果快照的已记录字段，使用已批准 ScoreProfile 新建评分版本。缺少必需字段时拒绝，不重跑物理模型、不修改原分数。返回异步应用 job_id。 此处为工具输入契约。

Schema 文件：`sim_rescore_results-input.schema.json`；实例文件：`sim_rescore_results-input.example.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "project_id": "proj_civil_demo",
  "source_result_set_id": "results_demo",
  "expected_source_hash": "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
  "score_profile_ref": {
    "object_id": "score_coverage_v2",
    "version": "1.0.0",
    "content_hash": "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
  },
  "allow_partial_source": false,
  "budget_ceiling": {
    "max_runs": 6,
    "max_parallel_runs": 2,
    "max_cpu_seconds": 600,
    "max_wall_seconds": 900,
    "max_memory_mib_per_worker": 1024,
    "max_output_bytes": 10485760
  },
  "idempotency_key": "rescore-demo-key-01"
}
```

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "project_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 3,
      "maxLength": 128,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
    },
    "source_result_set_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 3,
      "maxLength": 128,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
    },
    "expected_source_hash": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 71,
      "maxLength": 71,
      "pattern": "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
    },
    "score_profile_ref": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/ObjectRef"
    },
    "allow_partial_source": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": false
    },
    "budget_ceiling": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/Budget"
    },
    "approval_ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 3,
      "maxLength": 128,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
    },
    "idempotency_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 16,
      "maxLength": 128,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "project_id",
    "source_result_set_id",
    "expected_source_hash",
    "score_profile_ref",
    "allow_partial_source",
    "budget_ceiling",
    "idempotency_key"
  ],
  "$defs": {
    "Budget": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "max_runs": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 10000
        },
        "max_parallel_runs": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 64
        },
        "max_cpu_seconds": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 10000000
        },
        "max_wall_seconds": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 604800
        },
        "max_memory_mib_per_worker": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 128,
          "maximum": 1048576
        },
        "max_output_bytes": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1024,
          "maximum": 1099511627776
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "max_runs",
        "max_parallel_runs",
        "max_cpu_seconds",
        "max_wall_seconds",
        "max_memory_mib_per_worker",
        "max_output_bytes"
      ]
    },
    "ObjectRef": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "object_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 3,
          "maxLength": 128,
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
        },
        "version": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 5,
          "maxLength": 64,
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "content_hash": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 71,
          "maxLength": 71,
          "pattern": "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "object_id",
        "version",
        "content_hash"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

### C102 MCP  · 离线重算版本化指标 · 输出

仅读取指定不可变结果快照的已记录字段，使用已批准 ScoreProfile 新建评分版本。缺少必需字段时拒绝，不重跑物理模型、不修改原分数。返回异步应用 job_id。 此处为工具输出契约。

Schema 文件：`sim_rescore_results-output.schema.json`；实例文件：`sim_rescore_results-output.example.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "request_id": "req_demo_001",
  "data": {
    "job_id": "job_demo_rescore",
    "job_kind": "rescore",
    "state": "queued",
    "resource_uri": "sim://projects/proj_civil_demo/jobs/job_demo_rescore",
    "accepted_at_utc": "2026-10-04T06:40:00Z",
    "retained_until_utc": "2026-11-03T06:40:00Z",
    "accepted_budget": {
      "max_runs": 6,
      "max_parallel_runs": 2,
      "max_cpu_seconds": 600,
      "max_wall_seconds": 900,
      "max_memory_mib_per_worker": 1024,
      "max_output_bytes": 10485760
    },
    "planned_runs": 6,
    "poll_after_ms": 2000,
    "deduplicated": false
  }
}
```

#### 完整 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "ok": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "request_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 3,
      "maxLength": 128,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
    },
    "data": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/Receipt"
    },
    "error": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/Error"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "ok",
    "request_id"
  ],
  "oneOf": [
    {
      "properties": {
        "ok": {
          "const": true
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "data"
      ],
      "not": {
        "required": [
          "error"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "properties": {
        "ok": {
          "const": false
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "error"
      ],
      "not": {
        "required": [
          "data"
        ]
      }
    }
  ],
  "$defs": {
    "Budget": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "max_runs": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 10000
        },
        "max_parallel_runs": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 64
        },
        "max_cpu_seconds": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 10000000
        },
        "max_wall_seconds": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 604800
        },
        "max_memory_mib_per_worker": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 128,
          "maximum": 1048576
        },
        "max_output_bytes": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1024,
          "maximum": 1099511627776
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "max_runs",
        "max_parallel_runs",
        "max_cpu_seconds",
        "max_wall_seconds",
        "max_memory_mib_per_worker",
        "max_output_bytes"
      ]
    },
    "Diagnostic": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "code": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 64,
          "pattern": "^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$"
        },
        "severity": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "info",
            "warning",
            "error"
          ]
        },
        "pointer": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 0,
          "maxLength": 512
        },
        "message": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 1000
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "code",
        "severity",
        "pointer",
        "message"
      ]
    },
    "Error": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "code": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "INVALID_ARGUMENT",
            "NOT_FOUND_OR_FORBIDDEN",
            "REVISION_CONFLICT",
            "REFERENCE_CHANGED",
            "VALIDATION_REQUIRED",
            "BUDGET_EXCEEDED",
            "APPROVAL_REQUIRED",
            "IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT",
            "RESULTS_NOT_READY",
            "PARTIAL_SOURCE_NOT_ALLOWED",
            "RESCORE_FIELDS_MISSING",
            "INCOMPATIBLE_SCORE_PROFILE",
            "EXPIRED_HANDLE",
            "RATE_LIMITED",
            "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE",
            "INTERNAL_ERROR"
          ]
        },
        "message": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 1000
        },
        "retryable": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "retry_after_ms": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 3600000
        },
        "diagnostics": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Diagnostic"
          },
          "minItems": 0,
          "maxItems": 100
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "code",
        "message",
        "retryable",
        "diagnostics"
      ]
    },
    "Receipt": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "job_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 3,
          "maxLength": 128,
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
        },
        "job_kind": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "run_batch",
            "rescore"
          ]
        },
        "state": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "queued",
            "running"
          ]
        },
        "resource_uri": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 12,
          "maxLength": 512,
          "pattern": "^sim://projects/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/(?:catalog/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}|profiles/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)|drafts/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/[1-9][0-9]*|locks/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}|jobs/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}|runs/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/manifest|results/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}|artifacts/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/manifest)$"
        },
        "accepted_at_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 20,
          "maxLength": 35,
          "format": "date-time",
          "pattern": "Z$"
        },
        "retained_until_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 20,
          "maxLength": 35,
          "format": "date-time",
          "pattern": "Z$"
        },
        "accepted_budget": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Budget"
        },
        "planned_runs": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 10000
        },
        "poll_after_ms": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1000,
          "maximum": 60000
        },
        "deduplicated": {
          "type": "boolean"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "job_id",
        "job_kind",
        "state",
        "resource_uri",
        "accepted_at_utc",
        "retained_until_utc",
        "accepted_budget",
        "planned_runs",
        "poll_after_ms",
        "deduplicated"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

### C103 MCP 1.2 · 创建v12场景扩展草案 · 输入

#### 实例

```json
{
  "project_handle": "authorized_project_handle_01",
  "base_template_ref": {
    "object_id": "civil-base-experiment",
    "version": "1.0.0",
    "content_hash": "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb"
  },
  "scenario_manifest_ref": {
    "object_id": "scenario-extension-sat-alpha",
```

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:sim-v12-create-draft-input",
  "title": "sim-v12-create-draft-input",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "project_handle": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
    },
    "base_template_ref": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "object_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
        },
        "version": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "content_hash": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "object_id",
        "version",
        "content_hash"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "scenario_manifest_ref": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "object_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
        },
        "version": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "content_hash": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "object_id",
        "version",
        "content_hash"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "idempotency_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "project_handle",
    "base_template_ref",
    "scenario_manifest_ref",
    "idempotency_key"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

```json
                    },

                    },

                      "type": "integer",
```
```json
                      "minimum": 0
                    },

                      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
                    },
```

### C109 MCP 1.2 · 提出受限规则变更 · 输入

仅创建候选规则或公开评分参数提案；命名参数由批准目录解析。不能修改真值、权限、保留评分或seed，不能自批。 此处为工具输入契约。

```json
  "editing_policy_ref": "editing.public-thresholds@1.0.0",
```

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",

    },

      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "offline-evaluation",
        "runtime-outcome"
      ]
    },
    "edits": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "parameter_id": {
            "type": "string",

          },
          "value": {
            "type": [
              "number",
              "string",
              "boolean",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "unit": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 256
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "parameter_id",
          "value",
          "unit"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 32
    },
    "purpose": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "rule-sensitivity-study",
        "candidate-improvement-study"
      ]
    },
    "test_dataset_refs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 8,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "reason": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 256
    },
    "idempotency_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
    },
    "target_kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "outcome-rule",
        "score-profile"
      ]
    },
    "target_ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "parameter_catalog_ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schema_id",
    "target_hash",
    "basis_lock_handle",
    "editing_policy_ref",
    "change_kind",
    "edits",
    "purpose",
    "test_dataset_refs",
    "reason",
    "idempotency_key",
    "target_kind",
    "target_ref",
    "parameter_catalog_ref"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### C123 MCP 1.2 · 取消授权的v12作业 · 输入

仅控制权限主体可取消绑定operation；party只读访问不授予全局停止权。请求协作停止，保留结果，幂等且遵循终态CAS及fencing。 此处为工具输入契约。

Schema 文件：`sim_v12_cancel_operation-input.schema.json`；实例文件：`sim_v12_cancel_operation-input.example.json`

#### 实例

```json
{
  "operation_handle": "authorized_operation_handle_01",

}
```

```json
{

}
```

## 修订记录

本次依据Three.js原型的只读源码审查，将使用路径与现有内核、模型、实验、评分和权限规范贯通。只修改设计文件、参考契约与文档检查，不修改或发布原型。

## 主要变更

- 增加§36–43整体使用规范，作为详细HTML和完整Markdown的优先阅读入口；技术§1–35编号保持稳定
- 定义Project、WorkSession、AgentTask、DraftRevision、持久Job和ViewTab的所有权与独立状态；领域科学任务继续使用MissionTask语义
- 定义ContextManifest、ChangeSet、PreflightReport、ApprovalDecision、ApplyReceipt、WorkspaceSnapshot；UI、Agent、JSON编辑与有限console调用相同应用服务
- 把编辑、保存、冻结、运行、回放、重新评分、分支、取消与显示重置分成明确动作；提供机器动作目录与引用契约
- 在原DESIGN.md中实质修订架构、配置、命令、生命周期、回放、API、Three.js、安全、测试、实验与评分段落，具体位置记录于integration-patches.json

## 发现与修正

| 来源问题 | 修正决定 | 验收依据 |
|---|---|---|
| 新会话隐式克隆默认scene，研究对象不清楚 | Project持有对象，WorkSession持有明确引用 | UX01、UX02及§36–37 |
| 编辑与回放读同一可变scene | DraftRevision与RunProjection分离，历史结果固定 | UX11、UX22 |
| simulation.play/seek同时像显示和计算 | display命令只改游标，run命令独立回执 | UX08、UX09、UX31 |
| 隐藏会话／标签决定本地推进 | 生产Job不依赖视图生命周期 | UX07 |
| 多标签默认共享状态，不同入口open不一致 | (session_id,binding,kind)默认聚焦，显式同步组 | UX16、UX27、UX29 |
| 异步命令依赖“当前选中卫星” | 发起时固定目标与版本，迟到回执仍归原上下文 | UX02 |
| 文件过期后允许确认覆盖 | CAS拒绝，三方差异、合并或fork | UX01、UX06 |
| 实验控件并未影响原型采样函数 | 提交前列实际消费的因素、资产、指标；分别呈现显示预测 | UX23及§42现状矩阵 |
| 原型结果卡不具稳定ID或完整来源 | ArtifactRef和固定Run/Evaluation/source snapshot | UX11、UX25、UX32 |
| 研究组标签与数据隔离混淆 | 服务端scope与当前授权／历史cutoff；前端标签不授予权利 | UX12、UX15、UX17、UX26 |
| 网页／终端文字可能被误认批准 | 非可信内容不生成批准，Apply重新核验服务器记录 | UX03、UX14 |
| 审查发现物理commit会使pause的CAS不断失效 | 独立control_revision，和state_revision/commit_seq分离 | UX31 |
| 审查发现仅终态attempt决定分母会漏无attempt样本 | 总体来自固定RunPlan，attempt仅决定值／状态 | UX25、UX33 |
| 审查发现Run完成不等于导出交付 | 评价、投影、导出分别显示完整性与终态 | UX32 |
| 只读派生导出被误当成无批准读取 | 增加release scope、当前ACL、所需批准、预算与下载再检查 | UX35 |
| 冻结旧版本被误要求匹配当前head | 精确不可变来源仍可用，只对真实写目标做CAS | UX34 |
| 旧v12 validate工具实际包含冻结 | 明确validate-and-freeze兼容适配，只在freeze用例调用 | §41.4及动作目录 |
| 完整依赖闭包摘要可泄漏隐藏模型 | 对外仅授权scope闭包，完整闭包用服务器opaque handle核验 | §38及v13契约 |

## 最新使用角色与自由度要求

- 增加user-workflows与developer-workflows稳定入口，明确研究用户和扩展开发者两条路径，逐步列手工工作、可选Agent协助与必须产物
- 未接Agent也能完成研究；WorkSession可自动承载布局，无须先聊天
- 快速查看和可撤销编辑直接进行，一组有意义的变更一次预览；预算、代码执行、发布和数据释放仍按具体影响把关
- 增加从3D对象、固定结果窗口和对话引用开始的探索、分支比较、证据钉选；探索记录可非线性，正式比较仍固定证据。artifact.annotate为窄范围拟议端口，区分本地笔记undo与已保存注释新版本，不新增完整wire schema
- 原技术§1.5与§11同步两条使用路径，不仅把此要求留在新增章节

## 证据与限制

现状来自原型README、ADAPTERS、commands.js与main.jsx的只读检查。Kimi官方界面说明只支持布局参考，不为本系统提供权限或运行保证。8项新DTO为设计参考，签名、外部artifact和后端授权示例含明确synthetic-unresolved占位；参考逻辑测试不证明真实服务、持久事务、并发租约、数据非干扰、GPU或物理精度。

校验数量以contracts/qa中的最终机器报告为准；行为故事属于拟议验收，不能累加为已通过的运行测试。原型、现有站点、真实模型和Archify CLI均未在本轮执行或发布。

### v1.2 设计候选修订范围

本轮把新的实验假设与扩展要求落实为两条规范入口：第34节模型扩展、第35节场景扩展。第28–33节定义它们共用的信息、权限、规则、动力学、安全事件和突发事件语义。所有文件仍是实施前设计；未部署服务或运行真实空间模型。

### 本轮新增的完整路径

- 三种信息模式：omniscient-baseline、sensed-immediate、sensed-delayed；权限不随模式扩大
- 真值、测量、交付、各方知识、裁决依据、读取/预测分层；历史知识游标与当前授权同时生效
- 有版本的科学任务结果与评分参数提案、独立审核、CAS 发布及后续作业追踪
- 不同动力学假设与非权威预测模型分开；运行时切换须检查点、新分支及显式迁移
- 碰撞/接触筛查的 disabled、event-only、declared-state-effect；覆盖证据与空日志分开
- 模型能力驱动的定时、条件、随机事件编辑；一次物理发生、多方独立通知、幂等效果和 cause-token 恢复
- 复合卫星包含平台及两类载荷；typed ports、唯一共享资源拥有者、嵌套边界、严格实例绑定、导出来源与整棵快照
- 版本化 MCP 入口连接草案、校验、提交、范围化查询和受控规则编辑；旧全局 DTO 保留为受限内部/legacy 契约

### 审查发现与修复映射

| 反例或漏洞 | 修复与回归 |
|---|---|
| observed=10、delivered=15 的测量在12s已可用 | 按实际 admitted causal cursor 准入；历史回放不读未来；同Tick后阶段仍不可提前读取 |
| 延迟测量收到后被当作“新鲜” | valid/observed epoch 控制 freshness；learned epoch 只控制 retention；延迟不重置测量年龄 |
| 正确门禁节点存在，但另一条 truth→judge 旁路绕过它们 | 固定节点信息域签名，检查每一输入路径的门禁支配关系及批准 release |
| knowledge.learned_at 错用 available_at | 使用实际准入 cursor；可用但尚未准入不是已知 |
| 全局结果分母、ID/hash、事件跳号泄露其他机构 | PopulationScope、ScopedResultManifest、party-local revisions、当前权限检查和受限来源引用 |
| 预测图层直接读取未来真值或隐藏计划 | PredictionResult 固定授权知识来源、模型、cutoff、目标epoch和非权威标签；严格非空投影payload负例 |
| 阈值从0.8改0.5后把同一数据称为性能提高 | 区分规则敏感性与共同独立评价；固定任务总体、窗口、失败/未交付处理 |
| 一个固定阈值字段阻止扩展，评分权重又按数组索引定位 | 注册参数schema与RuleParameterCatalog；命名参数按稳定metric_ref映射；质量/等待/评分权重正例 |
| Agent修改权限、隐藏数据、种子或保留评分 | 严格proposal输入、允许参数目录、受信审核引用；编辑/计算/结果释放权限分开 |
| apply返回accepted却无法查询后续作业 | 判别输出返回evaluation或branch句柄，统一get_operation；取消要求独立控制权限 |
| 关闭接触检测后，完整空日志被算作零事件 | not-evaluated与CoverageCertificate；检测假设/对象/几何/窗口/分辨率逐项绑定 |
| failed证书却宣称continuous absence | true声明须complete-to-method、continuous、count0、无gaps且来源完整；采样无检出不证明连续无接触 |
| 零延迟模式携带5s延迟或随机延迟没有模型 | DeliveryProfile条件约束与逻辑时间校验 |
| 事件payload正确但target/handler/恢复不匹配；把无此状态的Composite当作平台事件叶模型 | 绑定asset/model type、payload schema、授权效果、恢复白名单和幂等effect key；独立event-demo与sat-alpha不混用，缺能力时不挂计划 |
| 重叠离线事件被首个恢复直接设为可用 | 每个occurrence拥有cause token，恢复只移除自身原因 |
| 数据DAG无环但事件订阅互相即时触发 | 数据、订阅和效果的组合图检查，正物理延迟显式化，运行预算作为第二道防护 |
| 同一payload蓝图复制后共享状态或重复平台电源 | 稳定层级实例ID、唯一provider/资源权威、独立私有状态与随机流；包含环/深度/节点预算 |
| adapter版本/能力/导出来源不匹配仍绑定成功 | 模型与场景参考校验修复，审查者原11个组合探针重新正确拒绝 |
| scope版指标重新接受valid:null或undefined:0 | 恢复质量/数值/原因联动约束，避免重引入缺失即零 |

### 替代与兼容

新增v12 envelope引用旧核心锁/运行摘要，不把扩展字段塞入旧严格DTO。旧五profile仍保留；新增关系由ScenarioExtensionManifest正式camelCase字段承载，并由工作流引用观测/交付/知识/结果/编辑策略。

旧M.7全局SourceRunManifest仅供特权评估服务；参与方用范围化清单。旧RenderFrame/API/MCP不能因客户端隐藏字段而视为权限投影。旧记录没有交付/受众元数据时，拒绝推断其曾公开或立即可知。

新增证据只证明结构与缩小参考逻辑。安全侧信道、真实授权/撤权、随机过程校准、数值精度、磁盘/worker并发、实际浏览器和完整authoring编译器仍须实施验收。详细统计以本次生成的validation-summary.json及各QA报告为准，不将不同测试层重复相加为“系统通过”。

本轮以能复现的反例检查契约是否足以支撑设计承诺，优先修复会破坏确定性、事务完整性、评分有效性或资源边界的问题。结论针对实施前设计；没有据此宣称已运行真实仿真、完成数值验证、验证磁盘断电耐久性或证明分布式部署安全。

此次修订包含破坏性候选契约变更。旧版和新版均未冻结为生产接口；发布前必须统一版本与迁移策略。以下“修复”表示规范与对应契约的修订方向；最终结构检查、纯参考回归与尚待实现的服务测试分别列示，不能混为一项通过结果。

## 高优先级修复

| 编号 | 反例或缺陷 | 修订 | 对应回归与证据边界 |
|---|---|---|---|
| R01 | 平局规则使用 request_id，但严格 DecisionProposal 不允许该字段；反向命名的 proposal_id 会选错请求 | request_id 必填；校验同 run 且待裁决；顺序固定为 priority 降序、rule_id、request_id、proposal_id | request/proposal 顺序相反并打乱输入；不存在、跨 run、终结请求拒绝。正文 24.2、24.4 |
| R02 | 同一 producer 两次提案都从 0 计数，两个未来同刻事件可能拥有相同排序键 | 生命周期 emission_seq，由内核事务预留；随 queue/journal/checkpoint 持久化；事件 ID 使用固定 run/producer/序号命名空间 | 跨事务同未来 Tick、回滚重试、检查点恢复及溢出。正文 6.1、7.1、9.3 |
| R03 | 一个模型走到 10 s，另一模型报告 4 s root；只回退公开位置会留下 10 s 求解器历史、RNG 和队列 | 候选尝试保存点覆盖全部可影响未来的状态；缩短边界先完整恢复；没有匹配 continuation 的稠密输出不能替代重新积分；离散跳变使导数/求解器历史缓存失效 | 直接到 4 s 与先到 10 s 再缩短对比公开/私有状态和后续推进。正文 7.3。参考状态模型不等于真实求解器验证 |
| R04 | A 依赖 B，B 被拒后 A 仍占资源；多资源请求可能仅获得一半资源 | depends_on_request_ids 显式依赖图；原子多 claim；closure-no-backfill 固定拒绝闭包及释放规则 | 未知/循环依赖、级联拒绝、部分资源不足、释放后不回填。正文 24.4.1 |
| R05 | RNG 由含 run_id 的 observation_id 派生，恢复分支或重试会改变科学噪声 | 科学 sample_key 与交付 ID 分开；RNG 排除 run/transaction/attempt；精确继续保留 randomness_namespace | 改 run_id、改变 attempt 或从检查点分支后，同 sample_key 的科学样本不变。正文 10.3、11.2 |
| R06 | 普通 reads 无法区别自身起点、旧快照和新鲜输出，可能误报自环或暗中滞后 | typed read_bindings.source；仅 current-stage 形成新鲜依赖；静态 PluginPackageManifest 与 resolved-instance PluginManifest 分开 | owned-start 自读合法、真实 fresh 环拒绝、不得自动降成 previous-commit。正文 8.1–8.3.1 |
| R07 | fsync 文件再发布数据库引用，断电仍可能丢失未同步的目录项 | 临时写入→fsync 文件→同文件系统原子不可覆盖发布→fsync 目录/新祖先→持久引用事务 | 各步骤 crash matrix；需指定存储环境实测。mock 调用顺序不能证明耐久性。正文 12.2 |
| R08 | phase 40 触发下一 microstep 的 phase 10，若重跑全阶段会再次积分、采样和抽随机数 | 边界输入多重集合及消费游标；连续候选只采用一次；后续微步仅处理触发事件且 dt=0；同阶段事件进下一微步；phase 50 排空后仅一次；禁止普通过去事件 | 一次连续采用、一次原定采样、零额外物理时间；回滚后消费游标恢复。正文 7.2 |
| E01 | 先展开巨大笛卡尔积再检查 max_runs，拒绝之前已耗尽内存 | 原始规模限制与 checked multiplication 先行；候选枚举和最终运行预算分开；排除谓词也有累计工作上限 | 巨大轴组合在枚举前拒绝；排除谓词错误/unknown/预算耗尽均失败。正文 25.4、附录 M.3 |
| E02 | MCP 承诺 seed/case/attempt/规范化及依赖版本，但核心锁和 manifest 无字段保存 | 锁和 manifest 明确 case、seed_plan、run_plan_id、验证器/规范化器/依赖清单；随机派生版本只在 seed_plan 中保存；物理/评分摘要依赖闭包由编译器推导，不直接哈希混合清单 | 往返序列化不丢字段；缺字段拒绝；矩阵长度及 case/重复索引唯一。正文 25.1.1、附录 M.3 |
| E04 | 利用率把不同站点区间混成一个并集，漏容量和 amount；假定了不存在的资源路径 | 冻结 resource_availability；逐资源容量时间积分；去重、连接、窗口裁切；越可用期/超容量拒绝 | 双资源同刻、不同容量、重复事件、部分窗口、零分母、非法占用。正文 26.2 |
| E05 | 目标指标都有字段，但硬约束指标、去重键或完整流证明缺失，仍可能得“可行高分” | 从全部目标和约束展开完整评分依赖闭包，核验实际记录而非仅看 provides | 缺约束字段、缺去重/分组键、未记录流与完整空流区别。正文 26.6、附录 M.7 |
| E06 | W1 租约失效后 W2 接管，W1 恢复仍能写；迟到 outbox 还可能启动已取消作业 | 单调 fencing_token；同一原子门校验 owner/attempt/token/expected_commit_seq 和写入；取消启动 CAS；重试上限及新 attempt | 旧 worker 发布全拒绝、取消后不重启、重试不增加统计分母。正文 15.1.1、附录 M.5。纯 CAS 示例不等于分布式证明 |
| I02 | 常见解析器吞掉重复键，1e400 可变成 Infinity；字符串窗口可按错误字典序比较 | 严格解码；有限值递归检查；typed Tick/seed/counter；区间与去重语义；Evidence/quality 联动约束 | 重复 JSON 键、非有限数、范围边界、空/逆序窗口、阶段事务 ID 和质量矛盾。正文 5.1、24.2 |

## 中低优先级但影响可用性的修复

| 编号 | 反例或缺陷 | 修订 | 对应回归 |
|---|---|---|---|
| E03 | 用 int64 Tick 类型校验 uint64 seed，拒绝部分合法种子或错误处理溢出 | Seed 与 Tick 分离；uint64 0…18446744073709551615；线路均为十进制字符串 | 最大合法值、上界加一、负数及数值型线路输入。正文 10.3、附录 M.3 |
| E07 | 文档允许 sparse inheritance，但 schema 要求所有字段，编辑器与核心行为矛盾 | v1 接受完整 resolved profile；inherits 仅溯源；编辑器展开后再发布 | 稀疏输入拒绝，展开对象通过，父链无环。正文 25.2 |
| E08 | target 方向只有目标值，没有偏差尺度；归一化可能按 maximize 错算 | target_deviation 明确绝对偏差和同单位正 scale；专用效用与 clamp | 目标处效用、对称偏差、零/错单位 scale、错误归一化类型。正文 26.2–26.3 |
| E09 | 模糊的成对 ε Pareto 比较可出现 A→B→C→A 支配环 | 固定原点零的量化效用再 exact dominance；保留原值与同格并列 | 三向量环反例、ε=0、格边界和排列不变。正文 26.3 |
| I01 | 配置组合器与正文的默认值覆盖顺序不一致 | 固定为组件默认→模板默认→父链→profile→实例覆盖→sweep；编辑器与编译器共用语义 | 同字段在多层设置时最终值及 provenance 一致。正文 25.2 |

## MCP 线路契约补齐

| 编号 | 反例或缺陷 | 修订 | 对应回归与边界 |
|---|---|---|---|
| W01 | wire 可接受 core 不接受的预发布或前导零版本，无法无损映射 | 两端固定稳定 MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH，不静默改写版本 | 前导零、预发布、build metadata 拒绝；稳定版本往返。附录 M.3 |
| W02 | quality=valid 可配 null，undefined 可配数值，造成无效指标被当成真实分数 | Metric.quality/value/reason_code/denominator 联动 | 有效有限数值、空分母、缺失/不适用/部分状态正反样例。附录 M.4 |
| W03 | 过宽 URI 正则允许未声明路径形状，与资源目录契约不一致 | 只接受具名资源模板和合法标识段，无点段、空段或任意 scheme | 模板/版本/路径负例；ACL 仍是服务端必做，不声称验证了真实安全漏洞。附录 M.7 |
| W04 | get_results 声称保留失败分母，却没有结构化入口读取无 commit 的失败样本与所有尝试 | source_run_manifest_ref 指向类型化不可变 SourceRunManifest，覆盖全部计划槽、attempts 和终态选择 | 没有 commit 的失败/未启动槽仍存在，planned_runs 与锁一致，重试不重复计数。附录 M.7 |

## 本轮没有冒充已完成的验证

- JSON Schema 正反样例、严格解码和有限语义检查，只证明交付契约及示例的对应行为
- 纯参考排序、裁决、候选回滚、CAS 和评分函数，只验证设计规则的缩小模型
- 尚须对实际内核、求解器、worker、数据库、文件系统与浏览器执行集成、并发、断电、性能及数值验证
- 物理准确性仍需独立参考数据与适用域证据；结果确定、评分公式一致，不等于模型符合现实

最终检查数量和通过结果以本次交付的 QA 文件为准。本记录不把未来测试清单表述为已经通过。

## 交付验证与使用

已完成：110 份独立 Schema 与配对实例、2 个补充指标实例、18 个 MCP 工具的 36 份输入输出 Schema 检查；新版 MCP 的 22 份文件已包含在独立 Schema 数中。修订 1.2 另有 20 个主契约结构负例、9 个合法变体、43 个组合关系负例、55 项信息流参考检查及 221 项独立参考与契约复核。页面完成 45 项基础纯函数、564 项通用页面自建 DOM 检查，以及新版 23 项纯函数和 8 项自建 DOM 检查。27 张原创图完成结构、引用及静态目视检查，其中 21 份 Archify typed JSON 通过本地官方 Schema 检查。保留并重跑 1.1 的内核、评分、线路及严格解码回归。各组有重叠，不相加宣称系统覆盖率。HTML 无重复 ID、内部断链或外部运行时资源。 修订1.3增加整体使用规范、8份应用操作契约、工作台及状态流程图，完整Markdown与HTML进行正文和契约一致性检查。具体参考状态计数见 revision13 验证文件。 新操作契约参考检查包括31个结构正例、23个结构负例、12个语义正例和36个语义拒绝例；参考效果仅覆盖明确列出的有限动作。 独立复核的12组参考探针通过；37项动作中12项有本轮ChangeSet结构覆盖，41项产品使用故事仍属于拟议实施验收。

### 验证边界

- 完整仿真模型、真实 LLM、持久数据库、任务 worker、ACL、令牌、缓存撤权和远程 MCP 服务没有部署或运行
- 本地文件与 localhost 浏览器访问受限，未绕过限制。真实浏览器布局、窄屏、键盘、辅助技术和 WebGL 未完成实测
- 纯函数、自建 DOM、JSON Schema 和参考状态机检查不等于产品或安全系统验收
- 图集为原创 SVG。已有 Archify typed JSON 的本地官方 Schema 检查不等于 Archify CLI 渲染；实际 CLI 执行仍待单独批准
- 原型程序和 Site 在本轮没有被修改或重新发布

### 重建

HTML 和 Markdown 都由相同正文与契约生成。源码包 README 给出完整依赖和命令。普通修改后执行：

```sh
node report/render_markdown.cjs
python3 report/run_validation.py
```

输出：`output/航天器系统仿真_可扩展实施设计.html` 与 `output/航天器系统仿真_完整设计.md`。Markdown 的 SVG 相对路径以源码包根目录为基准；包内同时提供该 Markdown 根目录副本。
